_note: Mirror state card (FOUR_FEATURES_SPEC 2.1, 2.2; app/pai_c/mirror). Levels: 0 unknown, 1 known with stated/inferred evidence only, 2 one shown/confirmed entry, 3 at least strong_entries_for_3 shown/confirmed entries. ready: the coverage_requirements.json mode named in ready.mode lists notebook coverage keys (said, self); ready.areas maps each key to the coverage areas that stand for it now that the card reads the Vault (education first: history goes with said). tension: pairs of {area, kind, fields} sides and a rule; different_field resolves each side's text to a study field (catalog study_fields wording, then study field titles, then field_words) and marks a tension when the families differ or both name different fields. source_labels: a document's filename wins, then the evidence capture, then the source type. text: the background text job's limits; praise_words and university_words are checked case-insensitively as whole words, a university word only when the card itself does not contain it.
